List Of Related Solution Proposed.heading: List Of Related Solution Proposed
List Of Related Solution Proposed.raw:
Code	Name	Description	Scopes
INA-SOL-01	Dual SCADA Architecture	Standardized plant SCADA plus a Head Office monitoring layer to enable remote visibility, consistent alarms, and a single operational “source of truth.”	Scope: Plant SCADA standard (templates, alarm philosophy), HO SCADA view, historian replication, OT-DMZ connectivity, governed tag/naming standards, northbound integration API layer.Owner Depts: Plant Ops · IMT
INA-SOL-02	MES Planning & Scheduling	One plan across plants; on-time dispatch; zero manual re-keying from ERP.	Scope: Finite scheduling; constraint rules (materials, assets, labor); roster/shift templates; rescheduling; order priority; Gantt; plan vs actual KPIs.Owner Depts: PC/Planning · Plant Ops · IMT
INA-SOL-04	MES Core Execution	Paperless execution with real-time WIP, cycle time, downtime capture.	Scope: Dispatch & operation confirmation; parameter capture; reason codes; Andon triggers; OEE (A/P/Q); genealogy; rework/hold flows.Owner Depts: Plant Ops · IMT
INA-SOL-05	Anode Tracking	Full genealogy Green→Baking→Rodding; locate any anode in <30s.	Scope: Unique ID; status lifecycle; location & transfer events; quality attributes; exception/hold; audit trail.Owner Depts: Carbon Ops · SQA · ILG
INA-SOL-07	DSS (Ops Playbooks)	Automated recommendations for stability/throughput based on KPIs.	Scope: Rules library; anomaly detection; recommended actions; target setpoints (advisory); cause-chain hints; ROI/impact tracking.Owner Depts: HO Ops · IMT(Data) · IPE
INA-SOL-08	LIMS	COA-ready lab results tied to lots; 100% instrument auto-capture.	Scope: Sample registration; instrument connectors; result validation/approval; COA; spec limits; audit trail; MES/Lab equipment interfaces.Owner Depts: SQA(Lab) · IMT
INA-SOL-09	QMS	Closed-loop NC/CAPA with spec management and audit trail.	Scope: NC intake; CAPA workflow; deviation & concession; spec/version management; approvals; SPC link; audit evidence.Owner Depts: SQA · IMT
INA-SOL-10	Kaizen Tracker	Digitized ideas→impact; RCA actions tracked to KPI deltas.	Scope: Idea intake; 5-Why/Fishbone; 5W2H/CPAR; benefit baseline vs after; owner & due date; leaderboard.Owner Depts: HO Ops Excellence · SQA
INA-SOL-17	Equipment Runtime Capture	Standard runtime/utilization for OEE and maintenance planning.	Scope: Run/idle/stop states; time-in-state; counters; utilization trend; reason tree; OEE signals.Owner Depts: Plant Ops · IMT
INA-SOL-18	CMMS/EAM + Andon	WO from alarms; PM/CM digital; MTBF/MTTR tracked.	Scope: WO lifecycle; PM templates; checklists & photos; spares & reservations; alarm→WO; mobile app; SAP PM/MM sync.Owner Depts: SMO · IMT · Plant Ops
INA-SOL-19	CBM (Condition-Based)	Online rule alerts prioritized by criticality; fewer unplanned stops.	Scope: Sensor portfolio (vibration/temp/pressure); thresholds; rule engine; event-to-CMMS; condition dashboards.Owner Depts: SMO · IPE · IMT
INA-SOL-20	Predictive Maintenance (ML)	Early failure warnings & RUL; spare readiness aligned.	Scope: Feature store; classification/regression models; RUL; alert thresholds; model retraining; MOC approvals.Owner Depts: SMO · IMT(Data) · IPE

List Of Related KPIs.heading: List Of Related KPIs
List Of Related KPIs.raw:
Code	Name	Priorities	Granularity	Definition	Notes	Owner
INA-KPI-001	Carbon Yield (%)	High	Daily	% usable carbon output vs input; high cost driver; daily to detect recipe/process drift early.		
INA-KPI-002	Carbon Paste Batch Right-First-Time (%)	High	Daily	% paste batches meeting spec without rework; high impact to throughput and scrap; daily to prevent compounding defects.		
INA-KPI-003	Baking Furnace Utilization (%)	High	Daily	Utilization of baking capacity vs available hours; constrains anode supply; daily for short-cycle scheduling decisions.		
INA-KPI-004	Green Anode Reject Rate (%)	High	Daily	% green anodes rejected/held at forming; high because it reduces supply to potlines; daily to catch tooling/recipe issues.		
INA-KPI-005	Anode Genealogy Completion (%)	High	Daily	% anodes with complete ID+status+location history; high for traceability and loss control; daily to correct scanning/transfer gaps.		
INA-KPI-006	Potline Current Efficiency (%)	High	Shift	Efficiency metric (metal produced vs theoretical); high because it drives output and energy; shift-level for operator actions/playbooks.		
INA-KPI-007	Anode Effect Frequency (events/cell-day)	High	Shift	Frequency of anode effects; high because it harms efficiency and stability; shift-level to drive immediate response actions.		
INA-KPI-008	Potline Stability Index (alarms + deviations)	High	Shift	Composite of critical alarm counts/deviation duration; high because instability causes losses; shift for real-time operational control.		
INA-KPI-009	Tap-to-Cast Lead Time (minutes)	High	Shift	Time from tapping to casting furnace receipt; high because molten quality decays with delay; shift to control logistics and exceptions.		
INA-KPI-010	Casting Yield (%)	High	Daily	% good product tons vs molten input; high because it reflects process loss/scrap; daily for rapid corrective action.		
INA-KPI-011	Casting Changeover Loss (tons or %)	Med	Weekly	Scrap/loss during changeovers; medium as it’s periodic; weekly to target SMED/standardization initiatives.		
INA-KPI-012	OEE (Availability/Performance/Quality) — Critical Lines	High	Daily	Standard runtime-based OEE for key lines; high to expose bottlenecks; daily to steer shift focus and maintenance priorities.		
INA-KPI-013	Power Generation Availability (%)	High	Daily	% generation capacity available vs installed; high because smelter depends on reliable energy; daily for dispatch decisions.		
INA-KPI-014	Energy Intensity (kWh/ton Al)	High	Daily	kWh consumed per ton produced; high cost + sustainability driver; daily to flag abnormal consumption quickly.		
INA-KPI-015	Peak Demand vs Contract (MW)	High	Daily	Peak load vs contracted limit; high due to penalty/curtailment risk; daily for demand response control.		
INA-KPI-016	Unplanned Utility Outage Minutes	High	Weekly	Minutes of unplanned outages in transmission/supply; high for production risk; weekly for reliability review cadence.		
INA-KPI-017	SCADA Critical Alarm Response Time (median minutes)	High	Shift	Median response time for critical alarms; high for safety/availability; shift-level to drive operator behavior.		
INA-KPI-018	Historian Tag Data Completeness (%)	Med	Weekly	% key tags with valid data (no gaps/outliers); medium but foundational for analytics; weekly governance review.		
INA-KPI-019	Preventive Maintenance Compliance (%)	High	Weekly	% PM tasks completed on schedule; high because PM prevents unplanned stops; weekly suits planning cycle.		
INA-KPI-020	Maintenance Schedule Adherence (%)	High	Weekly	% planned work executed as scheduled; high to stabilize operations; weekly aligns to frozen schedule windows.		
INA-KPI-021	Maintenance Backlog (weeks)	Med	Weekly	Backlog workload vs capacity; medium as it’s a balancing metric; weekly to prevent overload/deferral spiral.		
INA-KPI-022	MTBF — Critical Assets (hours)	High	Monthly	Reliability indicator for critical assets; high for availability; monthly to smooth noise and reveal trends.		
INA-KPI-023	MTTR — Critical Assets (hours)	High	Monthly	Repair speed indicator; high for uptime; monthly to measure improvement initiatives and spares strategy.		
INA-KPI-024	CBM Alert Closure Lead Time (hours)	High	Weekly	Time from condition alert to verified close; high to prevent failures; weekly to drive maintenance response discipline.		
INA-KPI-025	TRIR	High	Monthly	Total recordable incident rate; high safety KPI; monthly aligns to standard reporting and audit cycles.		
INA-KPI-026	PTW On-time Closeout (%)	High	Weekly	% permits closed with verification within SLA; high to avoid open hazards; weekly for supervisor action.		
INA-KPI-027	LOTO Verification Compliance (%)	High	Weekly	% isolations verified/recorded correctly; high because it prevents severe incidents; weekly governance cadence.		
INA-KPI-028	Environmental Exceedance Events (count)	High	Monthly	Count of exceedances vs limits; high compliance risk; monthly to align with reporting and corrective action review.		
INA-KPI-029	Near-Miss Reporting Rate (per 100 employees)	Med	Monthly	Indicator of reporting culture and hazard discovery; medium; monthly to trend participation and coaching.		
INA-KPI-030	Vehicle Zone/Proximity Violations (count)	High	Weekly	Safety mesh violation events; high for immediate risk; weekly to target hot-spots and enforce controls.		
INA-KPI-038	Production Plan Adherence (%)	High	Weekly	% actual vs planned output by area; high for throughput & customer promise; weekly aligns to planning cycle.		
INA-KPI-039	Schedule Stability (re-plans per week)	Med	Weekly	Count of schedule changes after freeze; medium (discipline indicator); weekly to reduce firefighting.		
INA-KPI-040	Energy Cost Variance (% vs budget)	Med	Monthly	Energy cost vs budget baseline; medium finance KPI; monthly to match budgeting/reporting cadence.		
INA-KPI-041	Lab Turnaround Time (hours)	High	Daily	Sample receipt to approved result; high because it gates release; daily to keep production/shipping flowing.		
INA-KPI-042	CoA Issuance Lead Time (hours)	High	Daily	Time from lot ready to CoA issued; high for customer shipment; daily to prevent dispatch delays.		
INA-KPI-043	Nonconformance Rate (% lots with NCR)	High	Weekly	% lots triggering NCR; high for cost/quality risk; weekly to review patterns and containment effectiveness.		
INA-KPI-044	CAPA On-time Closure (%)	High	Monthly	% CAPA closed by due date with verification; high for audit risk; monthly suits governance cadence.		
INA-KPI-045	SPC Out-of-Control Occurrences (count)	Med	Weekly	Count of SPC rule breaches; medium early-warning KPI; weekly to prioritize investigations and kaizen.		
INA-KPI-046	Customer Complaint Cycle Time (days)	Med	Monthly	Days to close complaint with evidence; medium but customer-facing; monthly to track SLA compliance.		
INA-KPI-047	Inbound OTIF (critical RM) (%)	Med	Weekly	On-time-in-full for critical materials; medium but prevents production risk; weekly to manage carrier performance.		
INA-KPI-048	Shipment OTIF (%)	High	Weekly	On-time-in-full outbound delivery; high for customer trust/revenue; weekly to act on delays and exceptions.		
INA-KPI-051	Asset Criticality Coverage (%)	Med	Monthly	% assets with criticality rating; medium foundational governance KPI; monthly to drive master data completion.		
INA-KPI-052	CBM Coverage of Critical Assets (%)	Med	Monthly	% critical assets monitored by sensors/rules; medium maturity KPI; monthly to track rollout progress.		
INA-KPI-053	Vehicle PM Compliance (%)	Med	Weekly	% vehicle PM done on time; medium reliability KPI; weekly to align with workshop planning rhythm.

rows.Impact: Unplanned stops/downtime reducing throughput

rows.Issue: Coke shipment delays reduce coke availability at silos.

rows.Current Workaround: Rely on minimum stock level and logistics rescheduling.

rows.Issue: Quarterly maintenance duration exceeds target and contributes to capacity loss.
rows.Impact: Lost production time (target 5 days vs 1 week plan) contributes to annual capacity gap.
rows.Current Workaround: Accept planned outage and ramp up after maintenance.

rows.Issue: Frequent breakdown of critical equipment (mixer/kneader line) creates downtime.
rows.Impact: Lower throughput vs target capacity and unstable production plan adherence.
rows.Current Workaround: Maintenance response after breakdown; conservative operating speed.

rows.Issue: Long changeover/overhaul (multi-shift) reduces productive time.
rows.Impact: Reduced availability and slower recovery to normal speed.
rows.Current Workaround: Ramp-up speed increase over several days after overhaul.

rows.Issue: QC results arrive after material has already been consumed (e.g., butt sodium).
rows.Impact: Quality risk and inability to segregate bad material before use.
rows.Current Workaround: Continue production; later segregation/countermeasure after results.

rows.Issue: Manual numbering/labeling causes duplicate/missing anode IDs.
rows.Impact: Reduced traceability, impacting abnormality analysis and corrective actions.

rows.Impact: Schedule slip and higher demurrage risk when unloading is interrupted.

rows.Issue: Demurrage occurs and is costly; vessel schedule visibility is limited.

rows.Impact: Longer lead time to deliver results; delays feedback to production teams.

rows.Impact: Searching historical evidence can take hours/half-day and slows CAPA.
